title: Annual physical
summary: A full-length visit with your primary provider: history, vitals, screenings and a plan for the year.
body:
The annual physical is the longest visit we book. We review what changed since last time, check vitals, update vaccines and screenings, and agree on next steps.

Book it two to three weeks ahead, earlier in the day if you are fasting for labs.
before: Book 2–3 weeks ahead|Ask whether labs are needed first|Fasting only if the front desk says so
bring: Photo ID and insurance card|List of medicines and doses|Questions, written down|Records from other doctors, if new
after: A summary appears in the patient area within two days|Lab results are posted when they arrive|We call if a result needs a visit

title: Same-day sick visit
summary: A short visit for a new problem: cough, sore throat, rash, sprain, ear or urinary symptoms.
body:
We hold same-day slots every morning. Call at 8:00 am; a nurse asks a few questions and books the right clinician.

If the nurse thinks you need emergency care, we say so on the call.
before: Call at 8:00 am for same-day|Note when symptoms started|Take your temperature if you can
bring: Insurance card|Medicines you take now|Any home test results
after: Written instructions in the patient area|We call after a day for symptoms that need a check

title: Follow-up for ongoing care
summary: Blood pressure, diabetes, thyroid, asthma and other conditions we check on a schedule.
body: Follow-ups are booked before you leave, usually every three to six months. Bring home readings if you take them.
before: Bring home readings|Fill any lab orders a week before
bring: Home blood pressure or glucose log|All medicines in their bottles|Questions
after: Updated plan in the patient area|Next visit booked at the desk

title: Lab draw
summary: A quick blood or urine draw with our nurse. No provider visit needed when the order is already placed.
body: Lab draws are walk-in on Saturday mornings and by appointment on weekdays. Fasting instructions are on the order.
before: Check if you need to fast|Drink water unless told otherwise
bring: Photo ID|Lab order, if from another office
after: Results are posted in the patient area|We call for results that need a visit

title: Vaccines and nurse visit
summary: Flu, tetanus, shingles and travel vaccines, plus blood pressure checks and injections.
body: Vaccines are walk-in on Saturday mornings and by appointment on weekdays. Seasonal clinics are listed under clinic sessions.
before: Bring your vaccine record|Wear short sleeves
after: Stay 15 minutes after a shot|Record added to your chart

title: Video visit
summary: A video call with a provider for results, medicine questions and some follow-ups.
body: Video visits are booked by phone. The link is sent by text and works in a phone browser; no app to install.
before: Charge your phone or laptop|Find a quiet room with a good signal
bring: Medicines in hand|A list of questions|Home readings if you have them
after: Summary in the patient area|Orders sent to the pharmacy you choose
